rows.en: ...What a ferocious wind. Like this, there's no way we can get close...
...What a ferocious wind! At this rate, we can't get anywhere near them!!
...What a wind! Like this, there's no way we're getting near those two!!
I have to save Methuss somehow...
How are we supposed to rescue Methuss...!?
...Methuss!! Hang in there!! I'm gonna save you!!
Methuss!! We have to save her, no matter what...!
That bastard...!! I'll never forgive him!!
Seamons and Seagorath's fierce winds turned the windmills and restored the city's functions.
Still, this wind... If it keeps blowing like this, things are going to get dangerous.
Who knows how long even Fuuto Tower can hold out...
Still, this wind... If it keeps blowing like this, things are going to get dangerous.
Still, this wind... If it keeps blowing like this, things are going to get dangerous.
Still, this wind... If it keeps blowing like this, things are going to get dangerous.
Still, this wind... If it keeps blowing like this, things are going to get dangerous.
But thanks to it, the power seems to be back.
Still, thanks to it, the power seems to be back.
But thanks to it, the power seems to be back.
Still, thanks to it, the power seems to be back.
But hey, looks like it got the power back on.
The systems are back...? Then that door that wouldn't open should open now too!
All right! Let's find another route!
Plus, there's that Ultra Warrior presence I sensed back there... I've gotta check it out!
The systems are back...? In that case, that door should open as well...
It's a detour, but it can't be helped. Let's find another route.
The systems are back...? Then that door that wouldn't open should open now too!
Let's look for another way!
The systems are back...? So that door should open as well, then...
Right. Let's look for another route.
The systems are back...? Does that mean the door that wouldn't open will open now...?
This the one? The MS (mobile suit) that Spider Man went and caught?
My research specializes in Dopants, but these MS are quite intriguing as well.
Such a splendid form... Now then, Methuss... Let me take a good look at your body.
...Stop it!!
Methuss, is it? I wonder what you'd taste like?
Y'see, I usually live on a diet of kaiju. But since you're here, I'd love a little taste of you too.
Stop that, Bogal! I have decided that this body is mine to study and observe.
Besides, I have prepared a meal for you. A rather luxurious feast, at that.
A feast...? ...Well now, I'm looking forward to that.
Twin Tail!! Come here!!
...Sir! How may I serve you?
Well, well, doesn't this one look delicious!? A nice, plump, juicy Twin Tail!
Kiiiiigwah!!
Groooooooh!!
The wind is too strong to get close!
What a wind! I can't get anywhere near!
The shutter's open/close mechanism is working.
Zero...!!
Mebius! Hikari!
...I knew it! So that faint presence I sensed earlier was you, Zero!
Zero, you came here too!?
Well... Less 'came' and more 'got dragged in by the anomaly', I'd say!
I see. Then it's the same for us. We were caught in the anomaly too, and woke up here.
We've explored the area a little, but we still don't know anything beyond that.
Still, what is this sudden gale...? ...This is no ordinary wind.
Seamons and Seagorath are behind it.
What? You mean kaiju are on a rampage!?
No point standing around talking here. I'll take you to our base.
Base?
I'll explain later!
Who are you...!?
Could it be! That presence earlier was...
Mebius... Are you saying the presence earlier was them?
Yes. You're all friends of Ultraman Zero, aren't you?
It's all right. I understand.
I'm Ultraman Mebius. And this is Ultraman Hikari.
When I sensed Zero's presence earlier, I realized... about all of you...
That there are heroes who were pulled in from other worlds, just like us.
Say, do you know anything about this gale? It came out of nowhere... It's no ordinary wind.
Seamons and Seagorath are the cause.
Seamons and Seagorath are the cause.
Seamons and Seagorath are the cause.
Seamons and Seagorath are the cause.
You mean Seamons and Seagorath have appeared?
Yeah. It's dangerous here. Let me take you to our base.
Yes. We'll explain everything at our base... I'll lead the way.
Yes. It's dangerous here. Let me take you to our base.
Sure! This isn't really the place, so let's head to our base!

notes.note: Zero's 'those two' = Seamons and Seagorath (the kaiju raising the wind, per 0112#0.30-36); source says 'those guys'.
Shotaro speaking for W; source is first-person 'I'll save you', kept as 'I'm gonna save you'.
'That bastard' taken as Weather Dopant (g=m), hence 'him'.

Rows 0.60-0.72 have no recovered speaker; they are party-dependent variants of one beat. 0.61 (Fuuto Tower) is probably W; 0.69/0.71 use the softer 'demo' (likely OOO/Zeta), 0.72 the rough 'mitai da ze' (Zero or Shotaro). Written speaker-neutral but tone-matched.
Source leaves 'thanks to it' implicit; 'it' = the wind (from 0.60). Same for 0.69-0.72.
Earlier beat at Weather Dopant's lair (Bogal, Weather, captive Methuss) setting up the Twin Tail feast seen in 0112#0.1-21. Kept the source's gloss 'MS (mobile suit)'.
Bogal (g=n) speaks in a feminine 'atashi' register; no pronouns used for Bogal. 'Shishoku' (sample-tasting) rendered 'a little taste of you'.
Twin Tail's crisp 'Ha!' acknowledgment to Weather Dopant (g=m) rendered 'Sir!'.
No speaker; may be a field/system message when approaching the kaiju. Kept the source's omitted subject ('too strong to get close') since the speaker isn't settled.
No speaker; rough male speech (Zero/Shotaro type). Subject restored as 'I'.
No speaker; reads as a field/system message for the shutter switch.
'Details later!' rendered 'I'll explain later!' (Zero is the one leading them).
Rows 0.18-0.35 are the no-Zero-in-party version of the 0.1-0.14 meeting; each party member has a variant (0.27-0.30, 0.32-0.35).
Mebius's 'wakatte imasu' rendered 'I understand' (in 0.24 he says he himself sensed it); 'we' would also be possible.
Sentence runs across 0.24-0.25; cut at the matching point.
Zeta's 'annai shimasu' rendered 'I'll lead the way'.
proofread: roar aligned with the same Seamons cry in story_004 (0112#0.31/0.35) and story_006 (0115#0.9).
proofread: roar aligned with the same Seagorath cry in story_004 (0112#0.32/0.36).

report: 80/80 rows examined. Unspeakered party-variant rows 0112#0.60-0.72 and 0113#0.3/0.4/0.8 inferred (see notes). 0112#0.90-0.102 is an earlier lair scene (Bogal/Weather/Methuss). No names outside the glossary.
